conflicts.description: Burns's and Thain's board start month. The IPO prospectus and the 2020 proxy say both joined in September 2017; every proxy from 2021 through 2026 says October 2017. No filing explains the change. Both memberships are recorded at year precision (2017).

Arora's committees in the original 2026 proxy. His biography box listed 'Audit', but the nominee table, the committee composition section and his 2025 appointment 8-K all give Nominating and Governance plus Compensation. The 2026-04-20 DEFR14A corrects the biography box as a typographical error. Recorded as Nominating and Governance plus Compensation.

Advaithi's committees in the 2021 proxy. The nominee table marks her with footnote (2), Nominating and Governance. The committee section, the proxy summary and her 2020 appointment 8-K put her on the Audit Committee only. Recorded per the committee section (Audit).

2021 board size. The 2021 proxy says the board 'currently consists of ten members', but the same proxy nominates eleven directors who 'currently' serve, including Wynaendts (appointed 2021-03-22, a week before filing). The ten-member line looks stale. The membership records give eleven.

Wynaendts's Citigroup board years. His 2021 appointment 8-K says he 'has served on the board of directors of Citigroup Inc. since 2019'; the 2026 proxy says 'from 2016 to 2021'. This only affects the other-boards field.

open_questions: Committee composition after the 2026-05-04 annual meeting. The latest proxy (as of 2026-03-23) still lists Trujillo on Nominating and Governance and Compensation. No later filing through 2026-10-04 says whether those seats were refilled, so current committee rows are the 2026 proxy minus Trujillo.
Burns and Thain start month: September 2017 (prospectus, 2020 proxy) or October 2017 (2021-2026 proxies). See conflicts.
Pre-IPO start dates are disclosed only to the month (or, for Burns and Thain, effectively the year). No filing gives a day.

Whether Al-Rumayyan's (2023) and Trujillo's (2026) exits were their own choice. The proxies say only that they would 'transition off' and that the Nominating and Governance Committee proposed ten of the eleven directors. end_reason is did_not_stand for both.

Graves's role from November 2010 to November 2011 (between his CEO stint and his VP Operations role) is not stated. Camp's pre-IPO employment status is not covered, so his independence span starts at the IPO prospectus date.

Committee changes between proxies are undated. Trujillo chaired Compensation in the 2020 and 2021 proxies and Eckert chaired it from the 2022 proxy. Ginsberg moved from Audit to Compensation between the 2021 and 2022 proxies and joined Nominating and Governance between the 2025 and 2026 proxies. Martello moved from Audit (IPO) to Compensation (2020 proxy).
Independence roles are aligned to board tenure. The filings give point-in-time determinations only (IPO prospectus and each proxy).

Other-board lists come from Uber's own bios as of each filing and are not checked against other issuers' filings. Pre-IPO prospectus bios don't say which companies are public (flagged public_company_stated_in_source=false), and boards the bios call private are omitted.

The pre-IPO voting agreement reserved two SoftBank-designated seats (vacant at IPO, subject to CFIUS approval). The agreement ended at the IPO closing, and no SoftBank designee appears in any later filing.

coverage.method: Current roster checked against the 2026 DEF 14A and its 2026-04-20 DEFR14A amendment, the 2026-05-04 annual-meeting 8-K (Item 5.07), every 8-K filed 2026-03-23 through 2026-09-15 (the only 5.02 was an officer change), and every Form 3 in the EDGAR submissions feed through 2026-09-21 (no new director since Arora).

IPO 424B4, every DEF 14A 2020-2026 (plus both DEFR14As), every 8-K with Item 5.02 (19) or Item 5.07 (7), and every post-IPO Form 3 reviewed. Departures are dated from 8-Ks; did-not-stand exits use the annual-meeting date from Item 5.07. Each proxy's roster reconciles with the prior one plus the dated joins and leaves.
Pre-IPO seats reconstructed from the IPO prospectus and later proxy bios only. Only directors still serving at the IPO are covered; earlier pre-IPO departures are not researched.
